decisions.reason: The portal is outside our classic display core and only lightly marketed so far, but it supports closer customer collaboration and process integration, which fits our strategic direction.
The packaging display solution is close to our core capabilities and its 2024 German Packaging Award signals strong market validation and brand value.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is a natural extension of our retail-display range and merits further scaling through our existing design, production and assembly setup.
The small counter display fits everyday in-store promotion demand and broadens our standard cardboard offer with little strategic or operational stretch.
The large freestanding information display is well within our competence, though its larger-format niche can be more project-dependent than smaller standard display formats.
